hints.title: Room Availability Tracking
hints.text: Sort the meetings by start time and maintain the set of currently free rooms and currently occupied rooms.

hints.title: Dual Priority Queue Structure
hints.text: Use a min-priority queue of available room numbers and another min-priority queue of busy rooms storing pair (end_time, room_number).

hints.title: Delayed Meeting Scheduling
hints.text: When scheduling a meeting, release all rooms whose end time is less than or equal to current meeting start time. If no room is free, wait for the earliest busy room to finish.

hints.title: Meeting Room Simulation Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import heapq

class Solution:
    def mostBooked(self, n: int, meetings: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        meetings.sort()
        free_rooms = list(range(n))
        heapq.heapify(free_rooms)
        busy_rooms = []
        count = [0] * n
        
        for start, end in meetings:
            duration = end - start
            while busy_rooms and busy_rooms[0][0] <= start:
                _, room = heapq.heappop(busy_rooms)
                heapq.heappush(free_rooms, room)
            
            if free_rooms:
                room = heapq.heappop(free_rooms)
                heapq.heappush(busy_rooms, (end, room))
            else:
                earliest_end, room = heapq.heappop(busy_rooms)
                heapq.heappush(busy_rooms, (earliest_end + duration, room))
            count[room] += 1
        
        max_meetings = max(count)
        return count.index(max_meetings)
```

complexity.time: O(m log m + m log n)
complexity.notes: Sorting meetings takes O(m log m); each meeting performs priority queue operations in O(log n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning all n rooms sequentially per meeting causes O(m * n) overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual heaps maintain minimum room indices and earliest completion times in logarithmic steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Maintains separate heaps for free room ids and busy room completion pairs.
